summary.text: Chris Moraitis is the Republican candidate for Michigan State Senate District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the August 4 Republican primary.
An attorney and partner at Schuitmaker Moraitis Law, he says he is running to defend constitutional freedoms, protect families and create jobs.

paragraphs.text: On his campaign website, Moraitis says he grew up in a single-parent household and took part in debate and Model United Nations in school before attending college and law school.
He describes himself as a partner at Schuitmaker Moraitis Law, a member of the Downtown Development Authority, and a past president of the Van Buren Bar Association.
Moraitis won the Republican primary with 42.6% of the vote (12,716 votes), ahead of Kenny Clevenger with 42.0% and Curtis Clark with 15.4%.
Ballotpedia lists endorsements from the Michigan Farm Bureau AgriPAC and Right to Life of Michigan PAC.
His website says he is committed to defending constitutional freedoms, protecting families, creating jobs, fixing roads responsibly and ensuring every child has access to a quality education.
